subject.title: Remove Kimi K2 and CrossModel provider relays

question: Should CodexBar preserve retired and future-unknown provider records for rollback and restoration, or intentionally delete their stored settings during a later config save?
rationale: The current branch deliberately codifies lossy decoding, but that policy can permanently erase credentials and also affects provider IDs beyond the two being retired; only the repository owner can authorize that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Round-trip unknown records
options.body: Keep unknown provider records inert and hidden while preserving their raw configuration through subsequent saves.

options.title: Migrate retired records to backup
options.body: Remove only the two known retired IDs after creating an explicit recoverable backup and clearly notifying affected users.

options.title: Accept destructive cleanup
options.body: Keep the lossy decoder and explicitly accept that upgrades, downgrades, and later restoration can permanently lose provider settings.

recommendation.title: Round-trip unknown records
recommendation.body: Keep unknown provider records inert and hidden while preserving their raw configuration through subsequent saves.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored both the provider-retirement policy and the implementation that selects the destructive config behavior.
